name: Audio Segmentation Pipeline Template
description: Flex Template for the Audio Segmentation & Stitching Pipeline (Dataflow).

parameters.name: input_subscription
parameters.label: Input Subscription
parameters.helpText: Full path of the Pub/Sub ordered subscription for raw continuous audio feeds (e.g. projects/your-project/subscriptions/continuous-audio-sub).

parameters.name: output_topic
parameters.label: Output Topic
parameters.helpText: Full path of the Pub/Sub topic to publish segmented audio metadata to.

parameters.name: staging_audio_bucket
parameters.label: Staging Audio Bucket
parameters.helpText: GCS bucket for storing temporary raw audio segments before segmentation.

parameters.name: max_transmission_duration_ms
parameters.label: Max Transmission Duration (MS)
parameters.helpText: Absolute limit on continuous transmission duration.

parameters.name: route_to_dlq
parameters.label: Route to DLQ
parameters.helpText: If false, exception bubbles immediately instead of Pub/Sub DLQ.

parameters.name: dlq_topic
parameters.label: DLQ Topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic to route Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) processing failures.

parameters.name: out_of_order_timeout_ms
parameters.label: Out Of Order Timeout (MS)
parameters.helpText: Milliseconds to wait for missing chunks before accepting a logical gap for audio feeds. Default: 60000ms.

parameters.name: stale_timeout_ms
parameters.label: Stale Timeout (MS)
parameters.helpText: Milliseconds before an incomplete transmission is flushed.
